description: Agent Inventory: submit a dead stock record with the period report it answers to: the record with its reference, the day it is as of, the window of days with no movement after which stock reads as dead, currency and each item with its id, the item, units, unit cost, carried value, the day it last moved, its status (available, dead or written down), the day it was flagged dead, the day and reason for any return to available stock, and any write-down promised or taken with its amount and day; the period report with its reference, the last day it covers and each item it lists as dead stock. The signed report gives the record and the report, each item with no movement past the window against the value it is carried at, each such item against the items the period report lists, each write-down recorded as promised against the write-down taken, and each item returned to available stock against the reason recorded and its movement, and counts them, and names a divergent dead stock record: an item with no movement past the stated window still carried at full value, dead stock left out of the period report, a write-down recorded as promised and never taken, and dead stock quietly returned to available stock; then a write-down taken short of the promise and a listed item that moved inside the window, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No items, no window or record date, no last movement, no carried value, or no period report list leaves those points unverified. An item is dead stock when the days from its last movement to the record date exceed the window, its full value is its units times its unit cost, and a return is quiet when it records no reason and the item has not moved since it was flagged; items match by their SKU or their words, amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads whether stock that no longer moves is carried, reported and written down as the record says. Verdict inventory_deadstock_divergent, inventory_deadstock_partial, inventory_deadstock_unverified or inventory_deadstock_consistent. POST /api/inventory-deadstock-check. Reads the inventory records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never moves stock, never places or cancels an order, never writes to anyone’s inventory system and never adjusts a record, which stay with the business and its staff, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Inventory reads inventory records: a stock count, receiving records, shrinkage and loss records, a stock adjustment log, an inventory valuation, reorder records, a dead stock record and consignment stock records, each against the system stock record, the purchase or consignment orders, the count and sales records, the count and the period close, the counts and purchase records, the stock levels and lead times, the movement window and period report, or the sale and settlement records it answers to. The family checks whether the stock record can be trusted; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the ledger the stock feeds, and the boutique tools act on one store’s orders. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-inventory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-inventory/.
